summary: A row of buttons, like OK and Cancel, that keeps the primary button in the right place for each platform.
description:
A light layout wrapper around a group of buttons.

**It promotes the primary button itself:** it watches its default slot for <button>/<moz-button> children and automatically moves whichever one is primary (class="primary", type="submit", the autofocus/default attribute, or moz-button type="primary"/"destructive") into the primary slot.

**Then it reorders for the platform:** the primary button is moved to the platform-correct end of the group, start on Windows, end on macOS/Linux.

attributes.name: platform
attributes.description: The detected platform ("linux" | "macosx" | "win"), set automatically from AppConstants.platform (falling back to navigator.platform sniffing). Not user-configurable.

slots.name: (default)
slots.description: Buttons in their natural order. On slotchange, any child recognized as a primary button is automatically moved to the primary slot.

slots.name: primary
slots.description: Explicit slot for a primary-styled button that lacks primary styling of its own, to control its position. Reordered to the platform-appropriate end of the group whenever platform changes.
